about: Pass 5.3 Lane B: manual field-coverage entries for the buildx items (POST /build query parameters whose Go names differ from the swagger names; the bake matrix/name attributes auto-map through the parser's case "matrix", "name").

engine:ImageBuild?q.skip: Output verbosity only (suppresses the step output stream; swagger: 'Suppress verbose build output'): it changes nothing in the image, and the provider needs the stream to report the image ID and to log build output at debug level.

engine:ImageBuild?rm.skip: The provider always sends rm=true (img_build_opts.go Remove: true) so a successful classic build never leaves intermediate containers that Terraform does not track; keeping containers after a failed step for debugging is build.force_rm = false.
